# Third-party scenery

Advenquo retains its original cultural artefacts and characters. Additional
environment props are selected from licensed creator downloads; Pinterest images
are visual references only and are not redistributed as game assets.

Source licenses and file provenance accompany each imported selection.

| Selection | Creator source | License | Included models |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Nature Kit 2.1 | https://kenney.nl/assets/nature-kit | CC0-1.0 | Tall and short palms, shrub, grass, two rocks |
| Furniture Kit 2.0 | https://kenney.nl/assets/furniture-kit | CC0-1.0 | Wooden bench, potted plant |

Only eight self-contained GLBs are shipped (109,768 bytes in total). The original
files are unmodified. Each pack directory includes the creator's `License.txt`
and a `provenance.json` with source archive and individual file SHA-256 hashes.
No external texture, model-service account, or API key is required at runtime.

The 22 placements in `public/scenes/main.iwsdk.scene.json` dress the edges of
the Ìsàlẹ̀ Èkó courtyard. Their `LocationAnchor` components keep them associated
with the market during travel. Nature Kit models have a local ground offset of
-0.05, compensated by their scene positions after scaling. Furniture models use
their original corner origins. Existing cultural objects and gameplay are retained.

Visual direction references, not redistributed assets:

- https://www.pinterest.com/pin/743234744785175363/ — Stylized African Assets, Ryan Manning
- https://www.pinterest.com/pin/784893041354219457/ — African Village Props, Fernando Delgado Pérez
- https://www.pinterest.com/pin/777152479489385079/ — SomeWHERE in Nigeria, Victor Abatan

These generic landscape and furniture props are set dressing, not representations
of specific Yoruba cultural artefacts. They have not been independently certified
as botanically accurate Nigerian species.
